base.note: Raw row alerts, no deduplication. Event delay is measured from first event row in evaluation window; boundary events may be partial.
base.evaluation_note: Predeclared context residual thresholds; incident-onset-only precision/recall, not raw sustained-row sensitivity. No label-based tuning.
